svg.title: Arbor skeleton on a seeded synthetic tree, and the golden angle
svg.desc: Max azimuth gap against number of slots for four turn angles, the specified branch geometry on a synthetic 192-process tree, and child to parent radius ratios.
svg.text: arbor (planned): phyllotaxis slots, Leonardo radii, one synthetic tree
b specified geometry, synthetic tree (192 processes)
Leonardo: r_parent^2 = sum r_child^2 (+ own); Murray: r_parent^3 = sum r_child^3. Dashed: the symmetric-split ratios.
